svg.title: Cartography — music video style reference (b2-cartography)
svg.desc: An admiralty chart with the song plotted on it. The lyric is set along the route, so the words are the road and the road is still being drawn. Frame is 1600x900; the strip below the frame is apparatus, not part of the film.

text.textPath: I'D TRAVEL ROUND THE WORLD FOR THE REST OF MY DAYS

svg.text: SECTION VARIATION — THE SAME STYLE AT FIVE POINTS IN THE SONG
The whole chart, no route on it yet. Title set

text.textPath: I'D SIT AND WATCH THE SAILORS IN THE COLD

svg.text: Zoomed to a coastline. Route grows a word at a

g.text: IT DOESN'T MATTER WHERE I GO
IN THE SUN OR IN THE SNOW

svg.text: Pulls all the way out. The route so far is one
The chart empties to open sea and seventeen

g.text: WALK UNTIL MY BOOTS ARE FADED BLUE

svg.text: A harbour at the largest scale in the film.
One port, and the route does not move.
